params.prompt: Edit reference image 1. Keep the exact composition of reference image 1: the open-plan office, the black-and-gold robots working at the desks, the empty office chair and the cardboard box with belongings in the sharp foreground. Recolor into a night scene with deep violet and electric magenta neon light from the windows and screens, mixed with warm orange lamp light on the floor, the chair and the box; city lights outside in pink and purple. Make the upper 45% of the frame (ceiling, sky, top of the windows) much darker - deep navy to near-black - so a white headline on top reads perfectly. Rich saturated colors, high contrast, cinematic. No text, no letters, no logos.
